producer_report.summary: Added `check_timing_claim` in `reading/surveys.rs`, wired as one `step!` line after `check_records_measure`. It refuses a code or tests reading that claims a delay or speed-up (a speed, delay or cut phrase with a duration figure, or a speed phrase with a stage noun, or a cut verb with a time word and a stage noun) unless a `Timeline:` assumption carries a `crates/` path, two or more durations, a stage-order marker, a source label and a claimed-figure word. The refusal text gives the reader what it lacks: the six stages in pipeline order, where `athena status` prints their medians, a request to label an unchecked figure, and an example whose path exists. No prompt is changed. Readings that add or change a reading check are exempt; the same declaration beside a pipeline file is not. Added 7 unit tests, 17 corpus cases, 14 input forms, a declaration test, the CHANGELOG entry and appended D190. The corpus case `ci-wait-time-spent-reading` now expects a refusal. Over the evidence records the check refuses 29 of 960 accepted readings (3.0%) and 1 of the newest 50, against the declared 4% estimate. The final full test run was blocked by a full disk; see open_issues.

open_issues: BLOCKED: the build disk filled during the workspace-wide test run. After the final edits, the `refusal_corpus` link fails with a linker bus error. I can't clear the target directory (outside the working copy). Athena's checks must re-run `cargo test --locked`. I expect it to pass: the corpus passed before the last edits, and the 7 unit tests passed after them.

Departure from the plan: `earlier` now fires only at the end of a sentence or before a preposition or conjunction (to, so, by, than, in, on, at, and, or, but, before, with, for, when, if, then, as, from). The plan's noun-exclusion list refused two real accepted readings that used `earlier` before other nouns.

Departure from the plan: the unit test for a root-cause request uses hand-built generated-line shapes. The corpus case `timing-claim-generated-root-cause-quotes-only` uses the real `hestia::root_cause_request`, and the steward cases use the real `slowdown_request`.

Gap: the gate is code or tests readings only, as planned. Job 20261025-034733-c453 had class `config`, so a speed-up reading of that class is not covered. Widening it would raise the refusal share; the replay at verification measures the share.
A one-off count over the evidence records is recorded in D190 as a count, not as a kept test.
mistakes: My first full-workspace `cargo test` filled the build disk and aborted. I should have run the targeted tests only, since Athena runs the full suite.
The first version of the `earlier` rule (a noun exclusion list) refused two real readings. I measured that and replaced it with a positive follower list.
learnings: `cargo test -p athena-core --lib` takes about 450 s. Use filters for iteration.
The corpus case `ci-wait-time-spent-reading` was Accept only because no check read speed claims; it is now Refuse(check_timing_claim).
check_records_measure triggers on summary and criterion text, so a steward slowdown request used as a summary is refused by it first.
